headline: Maritime Park Permits and Charter Bookings
reservation: Access to Indian Key and Lignumvitae Key requires private boat or official tour reservation, often departing from Robbie's or local marinas. Hotel and fishing charter availability for the 'Sportfishing Capital' peaks December through May, requiring advance planning. Check Florida State Parks for current tour boat maintenance schedules.

days.title: Coral Reefs and Mangrove Bays
days.start: Suggested: 8:00 AM from Whale Harbor Marina

stops.name: Alligator Reef Lighthouse
stops.detail: Snorkel the vibrant coral gardens surrounding the historic iron pile lighthouse structure.

stops.name: Robbie's Marina
stops.detail: Observe the large Atlantic tarpon that gather at the docks and explore local artisan stalls.

days.driving: Allow 15 minutes for local stops; conditions vary
days.note: Ocean visibility at the reef is highly dependent on wind speed and direction.

days.title: Island History and Tropical Botany
days.start: Suggested: 9:00 AM from Indian Key Fill

stops.name: Indian Key Historic State Park
stops.detail: Explore the ruins of a 19th-century wrecking village accessible only by watercraft.

stops.name: Windley Key Fossil Reef
stops.detail: Walk through an ancient coral quarry to see fossilized heads preserved in the rock walls.

days.driving: Allow 10 minutes; boat transfer time varies
days.note: Carry water for island walks as shade and facilities are extremely limited on the offshore keys.

days.title: Conservation and Deep Sea Lore

stops.name: History of Diving Museum
stops.detail: View an extensive collection of international diving helmets and maritime artifacts.

stops.name: Anne's Beach
stops.detail: Utilize the boardwalks to explore the shallow flats and mangroves at the southern end of the island.

days.note: Anne's Beach parking is limited; early arrival is suggested during holiday weekends.

intel.title: Waterway Navigation
intel.text: Many historic keys are only accessible by water. Renting a kayak or booking a local charter is necessary for sites like Indian Key; check tide charts to avoid grounding in shallow flats.

intel.title: Overseas Highway Constraints
intel.text: Parking at popular trailheads and marinas is often restricted to small gravel lots along the highway. Do not park on the road shoulder where prohibited, as towing is strictly enforced.

intel.title: Bay vs. Ocean Coverage
intel.text: Cellular signals are strong along the US-1 corridor but may drop when several miles offshore or deep within the mangrove canopy of Florida Bay.

intel.title: Marine Refueling
intel.text: Gas stations are frequent along the main highway, but marine fuel is concentrated at major marinas like Whale Harbor or Snake Creek. Verify pump hours if planning late-day returns.

intel.title: Sunset Rituals
intel.text: The bayside 'sunset hour' draws crowds to waterfront venues. Plan to arrive at your chosen viewpoint at least 45 minutes prior to the seasonal disappearance of the sun.

plan.arrival: Drive south from Miami (MIA) via the Overseas Highway, stopping in Key Largo for groceries before checking in to an Islamorada resort.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are best for the two-lane highway; oversized RVs may find turning and parking at marinas difficult.
plan.goldenHour: Morada Way Arts District for land-based colors or any bayside pier; seasonal clouds affect intensity.
